compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a side navigation menu for an app. The main contents and functions available in this UI screen include:

1. **Saved**: A section where saved items or bookmarks can be accessed.
2. **Search**: A function to search within the app.
3. **Recently Visited**: A section to view recently visited items or pages.
4. **Settings**: An option to manage the app's settings.
5. **Categories**: A list of categories, including "NOLA.com" and "Baton Rouge," which can be expanded or collapsed for more options.

The screen also shows the app version number (v3.6.3f52fb0a) at the bottom of the categories section. The top of the screen displays the time (12:00) and various status icons.
